author: shibotanSieg
quote: Another reviewer used the perfect word to describe this: simpulator. The female lead is not scripted to do anything to reciprocate the many, many, acts of service requested from the male lead. For a player base that is dominated by the male demographic, this is a baffling narrative design choice; not to mention the reputation this franchise has built itself upon to date. I don't think the gameplay is interesting or the player-environment interaction is especially enticing. Nothing this game does appears exceptional compared to previous franchise entries besides perhaps its scale and more realistic graphics. Whatever influenced the creative design decisions in GTA VI, it influenced them to the detriment of the ultimate product. Do not recommend.
